rationale: 13x relative volume accompanied an 18% gap-down open and flush to 28.05, printing a clear exhaustion low. The last five 1-minute candles then produced higher lows (28.56 → 29.20), mostly higher closes, and peak volume on the 29.00-29.17 advance, lifting price off the session low while the broad market rallies and VIX collapses. This mechanical sequence shows demand stepping in above the flush low with the stock still only 31% into the daily range and well below VWAP, setting up a mean-reversion bounce.
